note: How often a candidate is asked again (src/coprepan/schedule.py). Part of the acquisition policy (master plan O-1): how hard an outlet is revisited is a politeness and retention question, not an engineering default. While status is NOT_DECIDED no fetch can be planned for an external run. To decide: replace every 'not_decided' with a value, give the policy a version, set status to DECIDED, in a reviewed commit.
